items.title: Can GE Stock Compound Its Way Higher?
items.summary: Despite record revenue, GE Aerospace is falling further behind on orders. Spare parts delinquencies, a measure of shipments delayed by material shortages, grew last quarter. This is not a sign of weakness, but of demand so intense the company's industrial base cannot keep pace.

items.title: Quantinuum Stock Heads for Record After First Earnings Report Since IPO
items.summary: Quantinuum  topped analysts’ estimates in its first quarterly report as a public company, but the real story may not be in the numbers.  As an early-stage company,  Quantinuum’s  revenue is heavily tied to individual contracts and milestone deliveries.  The company “delivered a strong first quarter as a public company,” Jefferies analyst Kevin Garrigan said, noting that revenue, guidance, and bookings all came in ahead of Street estimates.

items.title: Honeywell International Stock: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish?
items.summary: Honeywell International has lagged behind the broader market over the past year, and analysts remain somewhat bullish about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: Honeywell Slides 5% As Future Growth Guidance At Chicago Investor Event Dissapoints
items.summary: Honeywell's CFO took the stage at a high-profile Deutsche Bank summit this morning, and within 75 minutes the stock was in freefall. One comment about future earnings targets appears to have lit the fuse.

items.summary: This jet engine powerhouse is flying high on real business strength, forcing investors to ask a disciplined question: is the engine's power already reflected in the ticket price.
